scope: Actual norm-degree valuation on every general Weierstrass coordinate ring over every field, with triangle derived from official max(2degp,2degq+3), multiplicativity from actual Algebra.norm and degree, and zero support proved. Extend to actual FunctionField. Actual coordinate values exp2/exp3, every vertical exp2/every nonvertical line exp3, actual t=X/Y exp(-1). Actual Weierstrass equation proves v(t^3*line-1)<1 and v(t^2*vertical-1)<1; actual valuation-ring residue maps send normalized elements to1. Derived surjective valuation, nontrivial value group, actual DVR, t is actual IsUniformizer and generates actual maximal ideal. Actual countercontrol: reciprocal X is not uniformizer and replacing t with reciprocal X makes normalized-line difference valuation1, failing residue-one criterion. No supplied valuation/DVR/coordinate-weight/normalization premises. Seven new Mathlib-backed modules, no earlier custom proof modules. Constructed norm-degree DVR and normalization only; canonical projective infinity local-ring equivalence/full canonical principal divisor/Weil-Tate/reciprocity/isogeny/Lang/Cartier/Jacobian/MOV-FR/all14 remain open. Same host/prover/Mathlib, no independent implementation/physical-host/parser/compiler refinement, canonical promotion/novelty/signed-standing claim.
